dedupe_keys.name: joint air traffic flow and capacity management large scaling dataset

description: A TU Wien-led team publishes large air-traffic flow and capacity-management benchmark instances and outputs. Zenodo provides parsed and unparsed instance archives, configuration files and experiment results under CC BY 4.0. The description lists airports, aircraft, airspace sectors, navigation edges, flights and assignment tables. Regional graphs extend to tens of thousands of navigation vertices and more than 31,000 flights, with capacity-scaled variants down to ten percent. These inputs can benchmark dynamic airspace configuration and rerouting algorithms. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this large-instance collection. Coverage is generated scenarios, not complete live air-traffic-control records. A limitation is that performance results depend on the generator, chosen traffic demand and decomposition heuristic; the accepted conference paper is a citation, not proof of operational deployment. The large archives were not downloaded and no parsed-to-unparsed conversion or solver run was checked.
